shortDescription: Commander, we are making a major landing on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} and we need you to go in and cover the various elements that have been jumbled up during the in run. Hold the landing point while four allied formations arrive and cover them as they move off to their own stations. Expect significant enemy pressure and attacks on the various allied units. This is a test for this mission shape. This is a large and complex mission.
longDescription: This will be a tough one. There'll be priorities everywhere.

contractObjectiveList.title: Hold the Beachhead as Allied Forces Disembark

dialogueContent.words: Hold the Min Target Area, as well as maintain security for the landing zone and get each convoy and lance to safety.
Commander, we've defended the assets as planned, well done.
The landing has failed, Commander. Our masters will not be pleased.
Can you believe it?  We were only meant to hold them off, and yet you've taken out every {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force. That's one for the books, boss --- fantastic work!
Convoy two is ready to move.
Cavalry lance is on the ground.
Last convoy is ready to move.
Convoy two has taken a loss.
Last convoy has taken a loss.
Convoy two is at the lift point.
Last convoy is at the lift point.
